newsitem.title: USA: Qualcomm gets $275 mln Globalstar contract.
newsitem.headline: Qualcomm gets $275 mln Globalstar contract.

text.p: QUALCOMM Inc said it received a $275 million contract from Globalstar LP to manufacture and supply Gateways for deployment of Globalstar's worldwide low-Earth-orbiting (LEO) satellite-based digital telecommunications system.

The multi-year agreement could grow to about $600 million for QUALCOMM as the Globalstar network is built out. In addition to the Gateways, the contract provides for associated services and the supply of optional equipment to Globalstar LP. QUALCOMM expects to begin shipping Gateways in fulfillment of the initial $275 million order in early 1998.
